title: Evaluator Inputs
description: v1 contract (task C-07, plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md M1-08 'Labeled input channel to the evaluator'; done-when 'Reviewed contract keeps entered values distinct from facts') for what the three-answer evaluator (services/api/app/scenario/three_answers) receives for ONE option at ONE study revision: the LABELLED site values it will compute from, each tagged with its measurement rank, display label and source kind so an entered, assumed or survey value stays distinct from a city fact all the way into the evaluator. For every engine input (lot area, frontage, depth, lot type, zoning district) exactly ONE GOVERNING record is chosen from the study's site facts by the plan's source order, and the city/computed facts that an architect's entered/assumed/survey value overrides travel with it in 'displaced' (never discarded, never overwritten in place - plan section 3 step 3 'Each shows its source and can be edited'; site_fact.schema.json 'editable'). The weakest governing rank is carried as 'site_measurement_rank' so each result can show the label of its weakest input (plan section 4 'Each result carries the label of its weakest input'), and 'depends_on_fact_ids' lists the governing fact ids so a change to any of them marks the result out of date (plan section 9). The rank/label/source-kind vocabulary is the site_fact contract's (site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/measurement_known and #/$defs/source): a record whose rank is entered, assumed or survey_entered carries its own fact id and label and can never be labelled 'City records'. 'unknown' is not a governing rank - an unknown value blocks an answer, it never feeds one.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published evaluator_inputs contract versions. 1.0.0 = C-07 initial shape. 1.1.0 (journey plan §2 step 4, wave 1 item 4; D-090-R109) adds the OPTIONAL, additive, INERT 'existing_building' slot (the architect's keep/remove plan and the governing existing-zoning-floor-area record). existing_building is OPTIONAL and may be absent or null; a document carrying a NON-NULL existing_building declares 1.1.0 (the version-binding allOf below), while a document with an absent or null slot may declare 1.0.0 or 1.1.0, so every valid 1.0.0 instance stays valid unchanged. The enum is append-only (new versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to it); the emitter declares 1.1.0 only when it fills the slot.

study_id.description: The study these inputs were built from (study.schema.json study_id).

option_id.description: The option these inputs are for (study.schema.json options[].option_id). Site facts are shared by every option; this names which option's evaluation they feed.

revision.description: The study revision these inputs were built from (study.schema.json revision.number). The results computed from them carry the same revision (plan section 9).

inputs.description: One GOVERNING record per engine input, chosen from the study's site facts by the plan's source order. At most one record per key.

site_measurement_rank.description: The weakest rank among the governing records (plan section 4 'Each result carries the label of its weakest input'). The evaluator stamps the answers it computes with this rank's label.

depends_on_fact_ids.description: The fact ids of the governing records (plan section 9, dependency-based invalidation). A change to any of them marks results built from these inputs out of date.

existing_building.description: OPTIONAL, additive, INERT slot (contract 1.1.0; journey plan §2 step 4, wave 1 item 4; D-090-R109). Carries the architect's keep/remove PLAN (architect-entered only, never a city source) and the GOVERNING existing-zoning-floor-area record built from the study's existing_zoning_floor_area site fact (B-05), so the keep/remove choice and the existing zoning floor area travel beside the evaluator inputs. INERT: the three-answer evaluator has no field for it yet - it does NOT change build_three_answer_inputs, the governing_input engine_key enum, or any engine output. It becomes load-bearing only once Lane A adds the matching ThreeAnswerInputs field and the A-07 existing-buildings §5b rule exist (journey plan §2 steps 4-6). OPTIONAL and may be absent or null; a non-null slot binds contract_version to 1.1.0 (the version-binding allOf below). The settled 'Remaining development capacity: Not confirmed' wording is untouched - nothing here computes or changes remaining capacity.

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key; it is allowed (optional) so an invalid fixture fails only for its stated defect under additionalProperties:false.

allOf.description: Version binding (contract 1.1.0; journey plan §2 step 4): a document carrying a non-null existing_building slot declares contract_version 1.1.0. An absent or null slot leaves the version unconstrained, so 1.0.0 stays valid for it. Expressed as anyOf (not if/then) so the stdlib and engine validators agree: either existing_building is null (or absent, since 'properties' is vacuous for an absent key), or contract_version is 1.1.0.

governing_input.description: One engine input the evaluator receives: the GOVERNING site value, its provenance tag (rank, label, source kind), and the facts it displaced. 'governing' is always true (a non-governing fact never appears as a record; it appears only inside another record's 'displaced').

key.description: The ThreeAnswerInputs field this value fills (services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/inputs.py). Mapped from the site_fact key: lot_area->lot_area_sq_ft, lot_frontage->lot_front_ft, lot_depth->lot_depth_ft, lot_type->lot_type, zoning_district->zoning_district. CLOSED enum; new engine inputs are added additively.

value.description: The governing value: a number for areas and lengths, text for lot type and district. Never null (an unknown value never governs) and never NaN/Infinity (strict JSON).

unit.description: Unit of a numeric value: square_feet for areas, feet for lengths; null for text values. Tied to the key.

fact_id.description: The id of the site fact that governs this input (site_fact.schema.json fact_id). Present for every record, including entered/assumed/survey records, so an edit is always traceable to its own fact.

governing.description: Always true: a record is the governing value for its key.

displaced.description: The facts this governing value overrides, newest-first is not required but order is stable. Empty when nothing was overridden (e.g. a lone city fact, or an entered value over a previously-unknown slot). An entered/assumed/survey value typically displaces the city/computed fact beside it (plan section 3 step 3; site_fact.schema.json 'editable': the city value is never overwritten in place).

allOf.description: Rank, label and source kind are tied one-to-one exactly as site_fact.schema.json ties them (#/$defs/measurement_known, #/$defs/source). An entered/assumed/survey record therefore can NEVER carry the 'City records' label or a city source kind, keeping an entered value distinct from a city fact (M1-08 done-when). Expressed with oneOf/const (not if/then) because the contracts validator's keyword allowlist excludes if/then.

Value type and unit per key: dimensions are strictly positive numbers with their unit; text values carry a null unit. Expressed with oneOf/const because the validator's keyword allowlist excludes if/then.

An 'assumed' value governs an input only when it is the sole value for that input: the plan uses an assumption where no sourced value exists (plan section 9 'Explicit assumptions'; section 3 step 4) and ties the override path to entered/survey_entered (site_fact.schema.json 'editable'), never to a stated assumption. So an assumed governing record NEVER displaces a fact - its 'displaced' list is empty. (A conflict between an assumption and a recorded value is refused upstream by the adapter; a governing 'assumed' record with any displaced fact is a malformed channel.) Expressed with anyOf/const (not if/then) because the validator's keyword allowlist excludes if/then.

displaced_fact.description: A site fact a governing value overrides, kept visible beside it (never discarded). Carries its own id, rank, tied label and value, so the architect can still see what the city/computed source said.

value.description: The overridden value as the source recorded it (number for areas/lengths, text otherwise). Never null (an unknown value is never a displaced fact: it blocks, it does not get overridden).

measurement_rank_known.description: Any site_fact measurement rank EXCEPT 'unknown' (site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/measurement_known): an unknown value never governs an answer and is never a displaced fact.

measurement_label_known.description: The display label tied to a known rank (site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/measurement_known labels, plan section 4 table and task M1-07). Tied one-to-one to the rank in the governing_input and displaced_fact allOf blocks.

source_kind.description: The site_fact source kind this value came from (site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/source 'kind'). Tied to the rank in the governing_input allOf: survey->survey_entered, city_dataset/city_filing->city_records, tax_map_computation->approximate_tax_map, architect_entry->entered, assumption->assumed.

existing_building.description: The INERT existing-building slot (contract 1.1.0). 'plan' is the architect's keep/remove choice (architect-entered, never a city source) or null when not provided; 'floor_area' is the governing existing-zoning-floor-area record built from the study's existing_zoning_floor_area site fact, or null when the study carries no such fact. The builder fills the slot when the caller supplies a plan or the study carries a KNOWN existing-floor-area fact; a lone unknown fact without a plan leaves the slot absent (the 1.0.0 output is unchanged).

plan.description: The architect's keep/remove plan, or null when not provided. Architect-entered only (basis 'entered', label 'Entered'); never a city source.

floor_area.description: The governing existing-zoning-floor-area record, or null when the study carries no existing_zoning_floor_area site fact. A known record governs (governing true); an unknown record is carried explicitly (governing false) with B-05's reason, so an unknown value stays visible and is never silently dropped.

existing_building_plan.description: The architect's keep/remove choice, mirroring the web step's closed vocabulary (study.schema.json existing_building_plan; apps/web existing-building-view EXISTING_BUILDING_PLANS / EXISTING_BUILDING_PLAN_LABELS). ALWAYS architect-entered: basis 'entered', label 'Entered' (the measurement vocabulary's architect-entry tie), never a city source, so the choice can never be shown as a city fact. 'statement' is the plain-words label for the chosen value.

value.description: The closed keep/remove vocabulary, byte-identical to study.schema.json existing_building_plan and the web step's EXISTING_BUILDING_PLANS.

basis.description: The plan is architect-entered. CONST 'entered' (the measurement rank for an architect entry); never a city source kind.

label.description: The display label tied one-to-one to basis 'entered' (measurement_label_known 'Entered').

statement.description: The plain-words plan label (apps/web EXISTING_BUILDING_PLAN_LABELS): 'No existing building', 'Keep the existing building' or 'Remove the existing building'.

existing_floor_area_record.description: The governing existing-zoning-floor-area record, built from the study's existing_zoning_floor_area site fact (B-05) through the SAME rank/label/source one-to-one tie the governing_input records use, EXTENDED with the 'unknown' rank because an unknown existing floor area is a valid, visible state here (it blocks remaining capacity; it is never a governing engine input). A known record (rank != unknown) carries a positive square-feet value, its tied source kind and governing=true; an unknown record carries value/unit/source_kind null and governing=false. 'note' is B-05's prose carried VERBATIM from the site fact: for a known value it includes the tax-lot scope statement ('stated for tax lot ...; whether the figure covers only this tax lot or a zoning lot of several tax lots is not established'); for an unknown value it is B-05's reason ('Needs existing zoning floor area: ...'). A stated assumption governs only when no city source exists - B-05's own precedence decided that before the fact reached here.

key.description: The site_fact key this record is built from (B-05). Deliberately NOT a member of the governing_input engine_key enum: existing floor area is carried in this slot, never as a ThreeAnswerInputs scalar (INERT until Lane A).

value.description: The existing zoning floor area in square feet when known (a positive number), or null when unknown. Never NaN/Infinity (strict JSON).

unit.description: square_feet when known; null when unknown.

fact_id.description: The id of the existing_zoning_floor_area site fact this record was built from (site_fact.schema.json fact_id), present for a known or an unknown record so the slot is always traceable to its fact.

source_kind.description: The site_fact source kind tied to the rank; null when unknown (an unknown fact has no source).

governing.description: true when the record is a known governing existing-floor-area value; false when unknown (an unknown value never governs - it blocks remaining capacity, plan section 3 step 4).

note.description: B-05's prose carried verbatim from the site fact (site_fact.schema.json note): the tax-lot scope statement for a known value, or B-05's reason for an unknown one. Null only if the source fact carried no note.

allOf.description: rank, label, source kind, value, unit and governing are tied one-to-one (the governing_input tie, extended with 'unknown'). A known rank carries its tied label and source kind, a positive square-feet value and governing=true; 'unknown' carries 'Unknown — enter', a null source kind, null value and unit, and governing=false. Expressed with oneOf/const (not if/then) because the contracts validator's keyword allowlist excludes if/then.

measurement_rank_any.description: Any site_fact measurement rank INCLUDING 'unknown' (site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/measurement). Used only by existing_floor_area_record, where an unknown existing floor area is a valid, visible state (it blocks remaining capacity, never feeds an engine input). Distinct from measurement_rank_known, which excludes 'unknown' because an unknown value never governs an engine input.

measurement_label_any.description: The display label tied to any rank including 'unknown' ('Unknown — enter'; site_fact.schema.json #/$defs/measurement labels). Tied one-to-one to the rank in the existing_floor_area_record allOf.
